environment.description: Same code deployed in an isolated ECS Fargate task container running the Lambda function via Lambda Web Adapter (LWA). The container uses a custom-built scratch-based image with a read-only root filesystem. The task definition specifies a Linux namespace configuration with a pivot_root to /srv/app (containing only the Python runtime and application code). The container's /proc is mounted with hidepid=2 and the process runs under a dedicated seccomp profile (based on Docker's default but additionally blocking socket creation syscalls: socket, socketpair, connect filtered to deny AF_INET/AF_INET6 for outbound). The ECS service sits behind an internal ALB with a listener rule that applies response header injection: all responses have Content-Type forcibly overwritten to 'application/json' via a fixed-response action's header, and a secondary rule applies a response transformation via a Lambda@Edge-equivalent (ALB Lambda target) that strips any response body containing unescaped angle brackets and replaces it with a JSON error. The ALB security group only allows ingress from a VPC endpoint for API Gateway private integration, and the API Gateway resource has a request validator requiring a JSON schema where filterTag is enum-constrained to ['electronics','books','clothing','home','sports'] and sortOrder to ['asc','desc'].

config.container: scratch-based OCI image, read-only rootfs, pivot_root to /srv/app
config.seccomp_profile: custom profile blocking socket/socketpair/connect for AF_INET/AF_INET6
config.alb_response_rules: fixed Content-Type: application/json header on all responses; secondary Lambda target strips bodies with unescaped angle brackets
config.alb_security_group: ingress only from com.amazonaws.us-east-1.execute-api VPC endpoint ENIs
config.api_gateway_validator: request body JSON schema: filterTag enum ['electronics','books','clothing','home','sports'], sortOrder enum ['asc','desc'], searchQuery pattern ^[\w\s]{0,100}$
config.network: private subnet, no internet gateway, no NAT
